{{- /* creator/backlinks.html — mini cards; hidden when empty unless params.backlinks.hideWhenEmpty = false. */ -}} {{- $page := .page -}} {{- $backlinks := $page.Backlinks -}} {{- $hideWhenEmpty := true -}} {{- with $page.Site.Params.backlinks -}}{{- if eq .hideWhenEmpty false -}}{{- $hideWhenEmpty = false -}}{{- end -}}{{- end -}} {{- if or (not $hideWhenEmpty) (gt (len $backlinks) 0) -}}

{{ i18n "creator.backlinks" }}

{{- range $backlinks -}} {{- $url := .RelPermalink -}} {{- $hit := false -}} {{- range first 1 (where $.nodes "url" $url) -}}{{- $hit = true -}}{{- partial "creator/card.html" (dict "node" . "kind" "mini") -}}{{- end -}} {{- if not $hit -}} {{ partial "page-title.html" . }} {{- end -}} {{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
